HD Map Industry Trends Driving Autonomous and Connected Mobility

2026-08-19 SNS Insider HD maps, autonomous vehicles, ADAS, lane-level positioning, TomTom, Waymo, HERE, NVIDIA, Baidu, Mapbox
Read the source article

Quick summary

The HD Map for Autonomous Vehicles market is projected to grow from USD 2.59B in 2024 to USD 22.97B by 2032 at 31.48% CAGR, driven by autonomous vehicle adoption, AI/LiDAR integration, V2X technology, and smart city investments.

Key takeaways

  • HD Map market estimated at USD 2.59 billion in 2024, forecasted to reach USD 22.97 billion by 2032 (31.48% CAGR)
  • Unlike regular navigation maps, HD maps provide lane-level positioning and localization essential for ADAS and autonomous driving
  • Key players include TomTom, Waymo, HERE Technologies, NVIDIA, Baidu, and Mapbox
  • TomTom partnered with Mitsubishi Electric (2024) integrating ADAS HD Maps with Mitsubishi's High-Definition Locator
  • Waymo began mapping Tokyo streets in 2025 using manually driven vehicles for high-quality 3D representation
  • HERE Technologies strengthened its alliance with BMW integrating standard and HD map data for lane-level positioning
